name: Hesby Bramble
features: BLOOD HUNTER 4 (Alternate, laserllama v2.2; Banked of Okton's order). Rite Die d4, Rite save DC 13
Hunter's Bane: Occult Lore (Religion); Sinister Insight (bonus action, CON check, DC 8+CR)
Blood Rites known: Binding, Blindness (each free once per rest, then Vital Sacrifice)
Crimson Offering (bonus action + Vital Sacrifice; 1 hour; Rite Die extra damage)
Vital Sacrifice: lose current and max HP equal to the Rite Die until a long rest
Order of the Pale Moon: Feral Senses; Lycanthropic Curse (Eagle, CR 0); Hybrid Form
Race (Bronze Dragonborn): Metallic ancestry (bronze): lightning breath (15 ft line, DEX save, 2d6 at 1st; uses = PB per long rest), resistance to lightning, Draconic Presence
Banked: advantage on saves against losing control of the burn; can bleed the heat off with a Vital Sacrifice (drops one stage for 24 hours)
notes: Age 46, male. Pre-conversion level 4. Rank: Raw (converted day 3). Thick, grizzled, grey-bearded, a sergeant's flat gaze. Watch sergeant who drew the Pyrehouse beat. Wife Marta thinks he is ill. Loyal to Halda and Okton.
